A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the coordination chemistry of the Schiff bases is very interesting and has been studied in great details in the last two decades.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Schiff base complexes are more stable than the amine complexes.
the coordination of the Schiff bases in the complexes is dependent upon the nature of the ligand and the metal ion.
